name: supervisor-create-worker-ready
description: The core asks a supervisor for a worker for each connection — routing, placement and capacity only — and is answered worker_created only once the worker has bound the connection's control socket, so the core can connect the moment it reads the reply; the core then sends connect, with the credential, on that socket. Placement (session model §4): a worker keeps the placement_key it was spawned with for its life, and takes another connection only of that key and only while it holds fewer than n_max. Here fixture-conn-2 carries fixture-conn-1's key and joins its worker; fixture-conn-3 carries another user's key and gets a worker of its own. Under per_user placement the key is the owning TSB user's login name, so one user's crash or compromised worker never reaches another user's sessions (Contract §4: users are tenants). list_workers reports each worker with its key, so a core restarted after kill -9 sees the boundary. In a collected capture, a worker given a connection of a second key, or listed with another key, fails.
